carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, filled action buttons, icons — the only assertive color in the system carries all interactive and typographic weight

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, product screenshot backgrounds, button labels on filled buttons

drafting-gray.$description: Drafting Gray — Page canvas, the base surface every component sits on; sets the off-white tone that makes cards read as elevated without shadow

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary headings and body emphasis, slightly softer than pure black for hierarchical depth

pencil-gray.$description: Pencil Gray — Muted helper text, inactive metadata, subtle icon fills, soft borders on secondary surfaces

faint-gray.$description: Faint Gray — Disabled state surfaces, ultra-quiet dividers, placeholder card backgrounds

charcoal-trace.$description: Charcoal Trace — Tertiary caption text, very subtle annotation labels

highlighter-amber.$description: Highlighter Amber — Annotation callout cards, highlight washes, tag pills — the single chromatic accent that mimics yellow highlighter on paper, used sparingly as functional punctuation not decoration

indigo-ink.$description: Indigo Ink — Pink outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges.

link-navy.$description: Link Navy — Outlined link borders and underlined text links — a classic editorial link blue, used only for inline hyperlink elements

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

van-condensed-pro-bold.$description: Hero display headlines, section titles — the signature voice. Used uppercase at tight tracking to create compressed, industrial-scale authority that contrasts against the soft canvas. The only place the system shouts.

inter.$description: Primary UI and body typeface. Carries 90% of the interface: navigation, buttons, body copy, list items, small headings. The 500/600 weights step in for UI emphasis; 700 is reserved for short label headings. Light negative tracking (-0.01em) at all sizes gives it a slightly tightened, modern feel without becoming display-level.

roboto-mono.$description: Code-style labels, keyboard shortcuts, technical metadata, monospaced micro-text within product chrome

inter-bold.$description: Inter-Bold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

noto-sans-mono.$description: Noto Sans Mono — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
